en: The metal gallium has a melting point of 29.76 degrees Celsius, meaning it will turn into a liquid puddle just by holding it in your warm hand.
Unlike almost all other substances, water expands and becomes less dense when it freezes into solid ice, which is why ice cubes float in your glass of water.
A mixture of cornstarch and water is a non-Newtonian fluid that acts like a solid when punched but flows like a liquid when poured.
When iron reacts with oxygen and water to form rust, the resulting chemical compound actually weighs more than the original solid piece of iron did.
Adding table salt to pure water increases its boiling point, which is why salted water must reach a higher temperature than plain water before bubbling.
Lightning is actually a superheated state of matter called plasma, where gases become so energetic that their electrons break free from atomic nuclei.
Mayonnaise is a stable emulsion, a special liquid mixture where tiny oil droplets are permanently suspended in vinegar using egg yolk as an emulsifier.
Water molecules stick together so tightly at the surface that they create strong surface tension, allowing lightweight insects like water striders to walk on ponds.
Mixing baking soda and vinegar causes a rapid chemical change that produces carbon dioxide gas, creating the fizzy bubbles that make homemade model volcanoes erupt.
Solid carbon dioxide, known as dry ice, undergoes sublimation at room temperature, transforming directly into a cold gas without ever melting into liquid first.
Osmium is the densest natural element on Earth, meaning a single liter of solid osmium would weigh over twenty-two kilograms.
Shining a flashlight through milk makes the light beam visible because suspended fat particles scatter the light rays in a phenomenon called the Tyndall effect.
